sources.name: DEC-102 P6 adoption pass
sources.detail: Top-50 candidate triage; board-approved 1-for-1 swap (Changing Loyalty -> Eternal Witness). Eternal Witness completes Living Death + Phyrexian Altar 3-card infinite combo and provides any-card graveyard recursion. The Wight of the Reliquary -> Vampiric Rites half of the original 2-for-2 was reverted because Vampiric Rites is not in the owner's collection.

sources.name: DEC-326 board-approved swap
sources.detail: Fauna Shaman -> Fiend Artisan. 2-drop B/G hybrid sac-tutor that puts a creature with MV <= X directly onto the battlefield (vs Fauna Shaman's discard-creature-tutor-to-hand). Non-Human for Mikaeus undying. Tutors Walking Ballista at X=0 (Ballista's library MV is 0) — directly assembles the Ballista+Mikaeus 2-card infinite death-trigger combo from any sac fodder. Scales as a finisher (+1/+1 per creature card in graveyard). Birthing Pod complement, not redundancy: Pod = +1 MV jumps locked, Artisan = flexible MV <= X.

sources.name: DEC-348 board-approved swaps
sources.detail: Upgrade assessment, 3 board-accepted 1-for-1 swaps: Immoral Bargain -> Warren Soultrader (free sac outlet + Treasure ramp + Gravecrawler infinite-drain line); Twilight Diviner -> Black Market Connections (Treasure/draw/body engine, fills ramp + card-advantage gaps); Witherbloom Charm -> Heroic Intervention (board-wide hexproof+indestructible, fills protection gap). Plunderer and Tireless Provisioner proposed but not accepted.

sources.name: DEC-348 board-approved swap (round 2)
sources.detail: Arcane Signet -> The Soul Stone. Rock-for-rock: indestructible {T}:Add{B} rock that harnesses into a per-upkeep reanimation engine. Ramp count unchanged; minor green-fixing trade (any-color -> mono-B), absorbed by ~25 remaining green sources.

sources.name: DEC-455 Flare of Malice assessment — board-approved watchlist (interaction 3ea6167f, 2026-07-17)
sources.detail: Flare of Malice (MH3, unowned, 6.9% Meren inclusion) assessed fleet-wide on board request: this deck free-casts it trivially (23 nontoken black bodies + recursive fodder) and the sac cost stacks Grave Pact triggers with Flare's own edict. Proposed swap (+Flare / -The Soul Stone) projected global 86->87, interaction 114->120, but closes removal-spot only to open a ramp gap. Board selected watchlist over both offered swaps: no decklist change; revisit on a flagged removal gap, a freed engine slot, or ownership.

sources.name: Board swap approval, DEC-929, 2026-09-28
sources.detail: Board comment 7864d22d on DEC-929: IN Simulacrum Shaper, OUT Carrion Feeder. Shaper puts a basic land onto the battlefield on every entry and draws a card when it dies; Meren returns it at end step from three experience counters, so a sacrifice plus the return nets a land and a card per turn cycle. Manabase health was the deck's weakest score (70; 36.1 lands against a 39.4 target). Carrion Feeder was the sixteenth sacrifice outlet in an outlet-saturated list (DEC-572). Warren Soultrader and Gray Merchant of Asphodel remain as the Zombies for the Gravecrawler loop.

guideContent.strategyOverview: Golgari reanimation engine that accumulates experience counters through sacrifice, then uses Meren's end-step trigger to return creatures from graveyard to hand or battlefield. Early turns deploy mana dorks for acceleration, plus Overlord of the Balemurk via impending to start milling immediately. Mid-game establishes sacrifice loops with Spore Frog for protection, Sakura-Tribe Elder for ramp, Bitterblossom for consistent token fodder, and Priest of Forgotten Gods for a multi-axis sac outlet that draws, drains, generates mana, and forces opponent sacrifices. Bloodghast provides self-recurring sac fodder that returns whenever a land enters under your control, Braids, Arisen Nightmare turns spare fodder into cards or opponent life loss at each end step, and Plaguecrafter loops with Meren for a repeating no-target edict. The drain package — Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, Bastion of Remembrance, and Sephiroth's permanent emblem — converts every death into opponent life loss. Plumb the Forbidden provides instant-speed mass sacrifice and card draw, doubling as a board wipe response. Black Market Connections compounds the engine with Treasure ramp, card draw, and changeling bodies every turn. Colossal Grave-Reaver turns every mill into free reanimation, and Buried Alive into a tutor-plus-reanimate package. Mikaeus, the Unhallowed gives all non-Human creatures undying, doubling the value of every sacrifice. With Yawgmoth's -1/-1 counters canceling undying's +1/+1 counters, the deck achieves infinite loops — draw the deck, drain all opponents with Blood Artist or Bastion of Remembrance, or repeatedly reanimate Gray Merchant and Kokusho for lethal drain. Walking Ballista at X=0 with Mikaeus creates the most compact infinite death trigger loop — Entomb + Reanimate assembles it. Gravecrawler provides a parallel infinite combo line with Phyrexian Altar and any other Zombie (Warren Soultrader or Gray Merchant of Asphodel). Simulacrum Shaper fetches a basic land on every entry and draws a card when it dies, so one sacrifice plus Meren's end-step return nets a land and a card each turn cycle. Late-game cheats in Archon of Cruelty for devastating value, or casts Living Death to reanimate an entire graveyard at once. Grave Pact locks opponents out of creatures while the drain battery closes the game.

winConditions.title: Gray Merchant Drain Loop
winConditions.description: Meren reanimates Gray Merchant at each end step once you have enough experience counters. Each ETB drains 6-10 life from each opponent based on black devotion. Over 2-3 turn cycles, cumulative drain reaches 40+ life across the table, killing all opponents without needing combat.

winConditions.title: Living Death Combo
winConditions.description: Cast Living Death to reanimate all creatures from graveyard. Eternal Witness returns Living Death to hand. Sacrifice all creatures to Phyrexian Altar for mana. Recast Living Death. Each cycle triggers Blood Artist for 1 drain per death. With 5+ creatures dying per cycle, infinite loops drain all opponents to 0.

winConditions.title: Kokusho Recursion
winConditions.description: Sacrifice Kokusho to drain 5 life from each opponent and gain 15. Meren reanimates Kokusho at end step. Repeat each turn cycle. With a sacrifice outlet like Ashnod's Altar, each loop is a 15-life swing across the table. Three cycles from a full table is lethal.

winConditions.title: Grave Pact Board Lock
winConditions.description: Sacrifice Bloodghast to Ashnod's Altar. Grave Pact forces each opponent to sacrifice a creature. Play a land to return Bloodghast for free. Repeat every turn to strip all opposing creatures. With the board clear, attack freely with Meren's reanimated threats to close the game.

winConditions.title: Overwhelming Reanimation
winConditions.description: Buried Alive tutors three creatures to the graveyard. Victimize sacrifices one creature to reanimate two. Living Death swaps all graveyards and battlefields, putting 8-15 creatures into play at once. A single resolved Living Death after dedicated graveyard filling typically ends the game through combined ETB triggers (including Archon of Cruelty's devastating sac-discard-drain) and combat.

winConditions.title: Sephiroth Emblem Drain
winConditions.description: Transform Sephiroth by having 4 creatures die in one turn (sac 4 to any altar). The permanent emblem drains an opponent 1 life per creature death forever. With Blood Artist + Zulaport + Bastion also in play, each death drains 4 per opponent. Any sacrifice loop or Living Death becomes lethal.

winConditions.title: Mikaeus + Yawgmoth Infinite Drain
winConditions.description: Sacrifice any 2 non-Human creatures to Yawgmoth alternately. Each sac draws a card and puts -1/-1 on the other creature, canceling the +1/+1 counter from undying. Both creatures loop infinitely. Blood Artist or Bastion of Remembrance drains each opponent for every death. With 25+ non-Human creatures in the deck, assembling this is trivial once Mikaeus and Yawgmoth are in play.

winConditions.title: Mikaeus + Yawgmoth + Gray Merchant
winConditions.description: Sacrifice Gary to Yawgmoth (draw, -1/-1 on any creature). Gary returns with undying +1/+1 counter, ETB drains all opponents based on black devotion. Yawgmoth sacs Gary again, -1/-1 cancels +1/+1, Gary returns and drains again. Each loop drains 6-10 life from each opponent. Gary's drain sustains Yawgmoth's 1-life payment. Near-infinite loops until library is empty.

winConditions.title: Mikaeus + Yawgmoth + Kokusho
winConditions.description: Same Yawgmoth loop as Gary. Each Kokusho death drains 5 from each opponent and you gain 15 (4-player). Yawgmoth's -1/-1 cancels undying +1/+1. Life gained from Kokusho easily sustains Yawgmoth's 1-life cost. Near-infinite drain until library is empty.

winConditions.title: Walking Ballista Undying Loop
winConditions.description: 2-card infinite death/ETB trigger engine. Cast Ballista at X=0 with Mikaeus out — enters as 1/1 (Mikaeus buff), no counters. Sacrifice to any outlet for the first death. Undying returns Ballista with 1 +1/+1 counter (now 2/2). Remove counter to ping itself — 1/1 with 1 damage, dies. Undying loops infinitely. Converts to a win via Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, Bastion of Remembrance, Grave Pact, or Altar of Dementia. Most compact Mikaeus combo — tutorable via Entomb/Buried Alive + any reanimate spell.

sources.detail: Mikaeus + Walking Ballista infinite death triggers

synergies.title: Fog Lock
synergies.description: Fog every turn for free at 1+ experience counters. Spore Frog sacrifices to prevent combat damage, Meren returns it at end step. Repeatable fog lock that shuts down combat-focused decks.

synergies.title: Free Ramp Loop
synergies.description: Sacrifice Sakura-Tribe Elder for a basic land, then Meren returns it at end step with 1+ XP. Net result: free land every turn cycle plus an experience counter each sacrifice.

synergies.title: Setup into Payoff
synergies.description: Buried Alive tutors 3 creatures to graveyard. Victimize sacrifices 1 creature to reanimate 2 of those targets. Net: pay 5 mana across 2 spells, get 2 premium creatures on battlefield plus an experience counter from the sacrifice.

synergies.title: Board Lock
synergies.description: Sacrifice Bloodghast to Ashnod's Altar. Opponents each sacrifice a creature (Grave Pact). Play a land, Bloodghast returns for free. Repeat every turn. Strips all opposing creatures at no card cost.

synergies.title: Priest Value Engine
synergies.description: Priest taps to sacrifice 2 creatures: opponents lose 2 life and sacrifice a creature, you add {B}{B} and draw a card. Bloodghast returns for free whenever a land enters under your control, providing repeat sacrifice fuel. Stacks with Grave Pact for 2 forced sacrifices per opponent per activation.

synergies.title: XP Proliferate
synergies.description: Sacrifice a creature to Yawgmoth: draw a card, put -1/-1 counter on a creature, AND proliferate (choose experience counters). With Bloodghast recurring for free, each land drop = sac draw + proliferate XP.

synergies.title: Gray Merchant Drain Loop
synergies.description: Meren reanimates Gray Merchant each end step. Each ETB drains 6-10 life from each opponent based on black devotion. 2-3 cycles = 40+ total drain across the table. Primary win condition.

synergies.title: Infinite Fodder
synergies.description: Sacrifice Bloodghast (1/1) to Phyrexian Altar for mana. Play a land, Bloodghast returns. Equip Skullclamp ({1}), Bloodghast dies, draw 2 cards. Net: each landfall = 1 mana + draw 2 cards.

synergies.title: Sephiroth Emblem Engine
synergies.description: Meren reanimates Sephiroth each end step at 3+ XP. ETB optionally sacs a creature for draw. Each creature death drains an opponent. After 4 deaths in one turn, Sephiroth transforms and grants a permanent emblem that drains on every future death — stacking with Blood Artist and Zulaport Cutthroat.

synergies.title: Token Sacrifice Factory
synergies.description: Bitterblossom creates a 1/1 flying token each upkeep. Equip Skullclamp to kill the token and draw 2. Grave Pact forces each opponent to sacrifice a creature. Net: draw 2, opponents each lose a creature, every turn for 1 life.

synergies.title: Drain Battery
synergies.description: Three simultaneous death-drain effects. Each creature death drains 3 life from each opponent (Blood Artist + Zulaport) or from each opponent per your creatures (Bastion). With Sephiroth's emblem, each death drains 4. Living Death resolving with these in play is typically lethal.

synergies.title: Archon Value Loop
synergies.description: Reanimate Archon from the graveyard; its ETB forces an opponent to sacrifice a creature/planeswalker, discard, and lose 3 while you draw a card and gain 3 life. Sacrifice it for a Meren experience counter, then return it at end step and reanimate again next turn for a recurring beating.

synergies.title: Overlord Mill Recursion
synergies.description: Overlord impends turn 2 for {1}{B}, milling 4 immediately. Once it becomes a creature, each attack mills 4 more and returns a creature to hand. Meren provides backup recursion at 5+ XP if Overlord dies. Independent hand-recursion when Meren is removed from the battlefield.

synergies.title: Mill-to-Battlefield Engine
synergies.description: Overlord mills 4 on enter or attack. Any creature cards milled trigger Colossal Grave-Reaver to put one directly onto the battlefield for free. With both in play, each Overlord attack mills 4 + reanimates a creature + returns another to hand. Grave-Reaver's own mill 3 on attack adds further triggers.

synergies.title: Buried Alive Reanimate
synergies.description: Buried Alive tutors 3 creature cards from library to graveyard. Grave-Reaver triggers — put one of those 3 directly onto the battlefield for free. Effective 3-mana tutor + free reanimate. Choose premium targets like Archon of Cruelty to reanimate immediately while setting up two more creatures for later.

synergies.title: Undying Engine
synergies.description: The deck's most powerful combo. All non-Human creatures gain undying from Mikaeus. Sacrifice any 2 to Yawgmoth alternately — each sac draws a card and puts -1/-1 on the other creature, canceling undying's +1/+1 counter. Both creatures loop infinitely. Add Blood Artist or Bastion of Remembrance to drain the table. 25+ non-Human creatures in the deck make this trivially easy to assemble. Commander Spellbook confirms 7 combo lines with this pairing.

synergies.title: Undying Sac Outlets
synergies.description: Every non-Human creature dies twice with Mikaeus — once normally, once with undying. Each altar sacrifice generates double mana. With Yawgmoth also in play to remove +1/+1 counters, loops go truly infinite: infinite colorless mana (Ashnod's) or infinite colored mana (Phyrexian). Altar of Dementia also combos the same way.

synergies.title: Ballista Undying Loop
synergies.description: Walking Ballista at X=0 with Mikaeus in play. Sacrifice to any outlet — undying returns Ballista with 1 +1/+1 counter (Mikaeus buff makes it 2/2). Remove counter to ping itself — dies at 1/1 with 1 damage. Undying loops. Infinite death triggers feed Blood Artist, Grave Pact, or Altar of Dementia for the win. Most compact Mikaeus combo — Entomb + Reanimate assembles it.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Mikaeus + Walking Ballista infinite death triggers

synergies.title: Gravecrawler Loop
synergies.description: Cast Gravecrawler for {B}. Sacrifice to Phyrexian Altar for {B}. Recast from graveyard — Warren Soultrader (or Gray Merchant of Asphodel) is a Zombie, enabling recursion. Infinite death triggers + infinite mana + infinite storm count. Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, or Bastion of Remembrance converts to lethal drain. Without the combo, Gravecrawler is recurring sac fodder for Skullclamp, Grave Pact, and Meren XP.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Gravecrawler + Phyrexian Altar infinite death triggers

synergies.title: Mikaeus + Yawgmoth + Gary Drain Loop
synergies.description: Sacrifice Gary to Yawgmoth — draw a card, put -1/-1 counter on any creature. Gary returns with undying, ETB drains all opponents based on black devotion. Yawgmoth sacs Gary again; -1/-1 cancels the +1/+1 undying counter, resetting the loop. Each iteration drains 6-10 life per opponent. Gary's life gain sustains Yawgmoth's 1-life payment.

synergies.title: Mikaeus + Yawgmoth + Kokusho Drain Loop
synergies.description: Sacrifice Kokusho to Yawgmoth — draw a card, put -1/-1 counter on any creature, Kokusho drains 5 from each opponent and you gain 15. Kokusho returns with undying; Yawgmoth sacs again and -1/-1 cancels the +1/+1 counter. Life gained from Kokusho easily sustains Yawgmoth's 1-life cost. Near-infinite drain until library is empty.

synergies.title: Liliana Draw Engine
synergies.description: Liliana's static draws a card whenever a creature you control dies. Bitterblossom creates a 1/1 token each upkeep — sacrifice it to any outlet for a free card draw plus Grave Pact forcing opponents to sacrifice. Liliana's +1 also creates 2/2 Zombie sac fodder. Her -4 forces each player to sacrifice two creatures, triggering her own static for 2 draws while opponents lose board presence.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Liliana synergy with existing sacrifice infrastructure

synergies.title: Tyvar Haste Tutor
synergies.description: Tyvar's static gives creature activated abilities haste. Fiend Artisan sacs+tutors a creature directly onto the battlefield the turn it enters — no waiting a turn cycle. Tyvar's +1 untaps Fiend Artisan for a second sorcery-speed activation in the same main phase. Two creature tutors-to-battlefield per turn with Tyvar out.

synergies.title: Fiend Artisan Combo Tutor
synergies.description: Walking Ballista's mana value in the library is 0 (X-cost cards count X as 0 outside the stack). Fiend Artisan at X=0 costs {B/G}, sacrifices a creature, and puts Walking Ballista directly onto the battlefield. With Mikaeus in play that immediately assembles the 2-card infinite death-trigger loop — Ballista enters as 1/1 (Mikaeus buff), sac to any outlet, undying returns it with 1 counter, remove counter to ping itself, dies, loops. Any sac fodder (Bloodghast, Bitterblossom token, mana dork) becomes a combo-assembly piece. Outside the Ballista line, Fiend Artisan also tutors Yawgmoth (X=3), Gray Merchant (X=5), Gravecrawler or Forsaken Miner (X=1), and any of the 2-3 drop combo creatures.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Mikaeus + Walking Ballista — Fiend Artisan tutors Ballista directly into play

sources.name: Scryfall - Walking Ballista
sources.detail: MV 0 in zones outside the stack (X-cost rule)

synergies.title: Tyvar Free Reanimate
synergies.description: Tyvar's -2 mills 3 and reanimates a creature with MV 2 or less from graveyard to battlefield. Hits 12+ targets including Blood Artist, Spore Frog, Sakura-Tribe Elder, Zulaport Cutthroat, and Gravecrawler. No XP counters needed — free reanimation on turn 3.

synergies.title: Teval's Value Engine
synergies.description: Every Meren end-step reanimate triggers Teval's Judgment. Bloodghast returning from graveyard via landfall triggers it again. Each trigger chooses draw, Treasure, or 2/2 Zombie Druid — with 3+ graveyard exits per turn cycle, all three modes fire. The Zombie Druid is Skullclamp/sac fodder and a Zombie type for Gravecrawler. The Treasure ramps or feeds Altar of Dementia's sacrifice needs.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Multi-trigger value engine with existing recursion loops

synergies.title: Harvester Death-Trigger Draw
synergies.description: Harvester of Souls draws a card whenever another nontoken creature dies. Each Meren end-step reanimate of a sac outlet target produces 1+ death and a card. With Mikaeus + a free outlet (Phyrexian Altar or Altar of Dementia), every undying double-death yields a draw on the second death (the first death excludes due to undying-counter timing — but the second death does count). With Phyrexian Altar/Yawgmoth loops, Harvester turns each combo line into deck-drawing alongside drain. Deathtouch on a 5/5 also makes it a removal threat in combat.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Death-trigger draw redundancy with sac engine

synergies.title: Repeatable Demonic Tutor
synergies.description: Emeritus enters prepared — immediately cast Demonic Tutor copy for {1}{B} to find any card. In Meren, 2+ creature deaths per turn cycle is nearly guaranteed, so Emeritus re-prepares at end step. Meren reanimates Emeritus at 4+ XP if it dies. Each turn cycle: sacrifice creatures, Emeritus repreps, cast Demonic Tutor, find combo pieces or answers. Non-Human for Mikaeus undying — if both are in play, Emeritus loops infinitely with Yawgmoth.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Repeatable tutor synergy with Meren recursion

synergies.title: Repeatable Reanimate Engine
synergies.description: Grave Researcher's upkeep surveil 1 fills the graveyard with reanimation targets. With 3+ creature cards in graveyard (trivial by turn 3-4), it becomes prepared and casts a Reanimate copy for {B}. Meren reanimates Researcher at 3+ XP if it dies. Two parallel reanimation engines — Meren's end-step trigger + Grave Researcher's prepared Reanimate — doubling the deck's recursion output each turn cycle.

synergies.title: Crime Loop Drain
synergies.description: Sacrifice Forsaken Miner to Phyrexian Altar for {B}. Blood Artist's death trigger targets an opponent — a crime — so Miner's ability lets you pay the floating {B} to return it to the battlefield. Net-zero mana loop: infinite death triggers and infinite drain with Blood Artist alone. Warren Soultrader works as an alternate outlet, Zulaport Cutthroat and Bastion of Remembrance multiply the drain, each iteration gives Meren an experience counter, and Altar of Dementia converts the loop to mill instead.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Forsaken Miner + Phyrexian Altar + Blood Artist; Soultrader variant: combo 2842-5544-5670

synergies.title: Doubled Death Punishment
synergies.description: Drivnod doubles every death-caused triggered ability of our permanents. With Grave Pact and Massacre Wurm out, one sacrifice makes each opponent sacrifice two creatures, and each of those deaths drains its controller twice — 8 life per opponent, 24 total at a vanilla 4-player table. Meren also gains two experience counters per creature death. Her end-step return is not doubled: it triggers at the end step, not on a death. Activated sacrifice outlets (e.g. Priest of Forgotten Gods) are not doubled either — only death-caused triggered abilities.

synergies.title: Recurring Edict Lock
synergies.description: Plaguecrafter enters and each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice; a player who can't discards a card. The effect targets nothing, so it answers hexproof and shroud commanders. Sacrifice Plaguecrafter, then Meren's end-step trigger returns it — to the battlefield at 3+ experience — for a repeat edict on all 3 opponents each turn cycle. Your own sacrifice feeds experience and the drain package.

synergies.title: Braids Symmetry Break
synergies.description: At your end step, sacrifice a Bitterblossom Faerie or Bloodghast to Braids. Each opponent may sacrifice a permanent that shares a card type with it; each who declines loses 2 life and you draw a card — up to 3 draws per turn cycle. Either branch profits you: the death feeds Meren experience and the drain package, and Bloodghast returns on your next land drop.

synergies.title: Shaper Land-and-Card Loop
synergies.description: Simulacrum Shaper fetches a basic land tapped when it enters and draws a card when it dies. Sacrifice it to Warren Soultrader for a Treasure, Meren returns it at end step once you have three experience counters, and it fetches again. One land, one card and one Treasure per turn cycle for no mana; the loop fires once per turn cycle, on your own end step.

highlights.name: Birthing Pod
highlights.reason: Repeatable creature tutor chain. Sacrifice feeds Meren XP counters. Pod from 2-drop to 3-drop to 4-drop maps perfectly onto the deck's creature curve.

highlights.name: Eternal Witness
highlights.reason: Any-card graveyard recursion on a 2/1 body. ETB returns target card from graveyard to hand — recurs Reanimate / Living Death / Toxic Deluge / Buried Alive for double-dipping. Completes the Living Death + Phyrexian Altar 3-card infinite ETB/death/sac combo. Meren can reanimate it directly.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook combo 864-2596-4050
sources.detail: Living Death + Eternal Witness + Phyrexian Altar — infinite ETB/death/sac

highlights.name: Emeritus of Woe
highlights.reason: Repeatable Demonic Tutor on a 5/4 creature body. Enters prepared — immediately cast Demonic Tutor for {1}{B}. Re-prepares at end step when 2+ creatures died (trivial in Meren). Meren reanimates it at 4 XP for repeatable tutoring. Non-Human for Mikaeus undying. Greater Good target (draw 5).

highlights.name: Skullclamp
highlights.reason: Draw 2 per 1-toughness creature death; 10+ targets in deck including mana dorks, Bloodghast, and Bitterblossom tokens

highlights.name: Living Death
highlights.reason: Signature Meren finisher: swap all graveyards with battlefields. After filling graveyard with dredge and self-mill, reanimate 8-15 creatures at once.

highlights.name: Yawgmoth, Thran Physician
highlights.reason: Sacrifice outlet + card draw + proliferate experience counters + removal. Does everything Meren wants in one card.

highlights.name: Grave Pact
highlights.reason: Opponents sacrifice a creature whenever yours dies. With free sacrifice outlets and self-recurring creatures, locks opponents out of creatures entirely.

highlights.name: Spore Frog
highlights.reason: Recurring fog lock with Meren. Sacrifice to prevent all combat damage, Meren brings it back every end step. Shuts down combat-focused decks.

highlights.name: Insidious Roots
highlights.reason: Per-trigger Plant token + +1/+1 counter on each Plant whenever creature cards leave your graveyard. Fires on every reanimation engine: Meren end-step, Bloodghast landfall, Gravecrawler recast, every reanimate spell, Tyvar -2, Grave Researcher, and Living Death. Static also gives every creature token (Faeries, Zombies, Soldiers, Treasures-as-mana via Teval) the ability to tap for any color. With Tyvar's haste static, plants tap for mana the turn they're created — true ramp engine, not just a counter pile.

highlights.name: Culling the Weak
highlights.reason: {B} instant: sacrifice a creature, add {B}{B}{B}{B}. Net +{B}{B}{B} ritual where the sacrifice cost is upside — triggers Meren XP, Blood Artist / Zulaport / Bastion drain, Sephiroth death counter, Grave Pact opponent sac, Yawgmoth proliferate, and Insidious Roots Plant trigger. Self-recurring fodder (Bloodghast, Gravecrawler, Forsaken Miner) makes the sac effectively free. Enables explosive turn-2 Mikaeus / Yawgmoth / Reanimate-Archon plays and instant-speed lines (Plumb the Forbidden, or floating {B}{B}{B}{B} in response to removal). Also unlocks the Changing Loyalty + Toxic Deluge steal-and-wipe line at 7-8 mana.

highlights.name: Kokusho, the Evening Star
highlights.reason: Each death drains 5 life from each opponent and you gain 15. Recurse with Meren for 15-life swings per cycle.

sources.name: Commander Mechanic - Plunder the Graves Update

highlights.name: Harvester of Souls
highlights.reason: Repeatable card draw on a death trigger: "Whenever another nontoken creature dies, you may draw a card." Deathtouch on a 5/5 body makes it a combat threat as well. With ~14 creature deaths possible per turn cycle in Meren combos, Harvester chains into deck-drawing. Non-Human for Mikaeus undying. Direct upgrade over Umbral Collar Zealot — replaces a redundant 14th sac outlet (surveil 1 was the weakest filter we had) with the dedicated card-draw piece the deck was missing.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Board-approved swap for Umbral Collar Zealot (DEC-192) — addresses card-draw role gap (70 → 80) and trims excess sac outlet count (14 → 13)

highlights.name: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER
highlights.reason: Sacrifice outlet, death drain, card draw, and permanent emblem win condition in one 3-CMC creature. ETB/attack sacs for draw; each creature death drains an opponent. Transform at 4 deaths creates irremovable emblem.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Multi-role engine piece for sacrifice/drain strategy

highlights.name: Bitterblossom
highlights.reason: Creates a 1/1 flying token every upkeep for 1 life. Consistent sac fodder for Skullclamp, Grave Pact, and all sacrifice outlets. Enchantment-based so survives creature board wipes.

highlights.name: Zulaport Cutthroat
highlights.reason: Blood Artist redundancy — each creature death drains each opponent for 1. Critical for consistent drain win condition. At 1/1, also a Skullclamp target.

highlights.name: Bastion of Remembrance
highlights.reason: Third Blood Artist effect on an enchantment — harder to remove than creatures. Creates a 1/1 Human Soldier token on ETB. Survives Toxic Deluge and Living Death.

highlights.name: Grave Researcher
highlights.reason: Repeatable Reanimate on a 3/3 creature body. Upkeep surveil 1 passively fills the graveyard. Becomes prepared when 3+ creature cards in graveyard (trivially easy). Prepared spell is Reanimate ({B}) — the strongest reanimation spell in the game, repeatable every turn cycle. CMC 3 for easy Meren recursion at 3 XP. Non-Human for Mikaeus undying.

highlights.name: Archon of Cruelty
highlights.reason: Premium reanimation target. ETB and attack: opponent sacrifices creature/planeswalker, discards a card, loses 3 life; you draw a card, gain 3 life. Buried Alive into Reanimate for devastating value.

highlights.name: Overlord of the Balemurk
highlights.reason: Impending {1}{B} on turn 2 starts milling immediately. Mill 4 on enter/attack fills the graveyard; returns a creature to hand for backup recursion independent of Meren and XP. Survives creature board wipes and Living Death in enchantment form. 5/5 body is a solid Greater Good or Altar of Dementia target once time counters are removed.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Early graveyard fill + backup recursion engine

highlights.name: Colossal Grave-Reaver
highlights.reason: Turns every mill, dredge, and tutor-to-graveyard effect into free reanimation. Mill 3 on enter/attack feeds itself. Buried Alive + Grave-Reaver = tutor 3 creatures, immediately reanimate one for free. 7/6 flying premium reanimation target alongside Archon of Cruelty.

highlights.name: Mikaeus, the Unhallowed
highlights.reason: Global undying for all non-Human creatures doubles the value of every sacrifice. Combined with Yawgmoth's -1/-1 counters to cancel undying's +1/+1, enables infinite loops that draw the deck and drain all opponents. Commander Spellbook confirms 6 combo lines with existing cards: Yawgmoth + Gray Merchant for infinite ETB drain, Yawgmoth + Kokusho for infinite death drain, and sac outlet combos with Ashnod's/Phyrexian Altar and Altar of Dementia.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: 7 included combos with existing deck cards

highlights.name: Walking Ballista
highlights.reason: 2-card infinite death/ETB trigger engine with Mikaeus. Cast at X=0 for {0} — enters as 1/1 (Mikaeus buff), sac to any outlet, undying returns with 1 counter, remove counter to ping itself, dies, loops infinitely. Converts to a win via any death payoff (Blood Artist, Zulaport, Bastion, Grave Pact, Altar of Dementia). Also a flexible mana sink at any X cost and free Meren XP trigger at X=0.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Mikaeus + Walking Ballista infinite death triggers

highlights.name: Gravecrawler
highlights.reason: Self-recurring Zombie for {B} as long as you control a Zombie (Warren Soultrader, Gray Merchant of Asphodel, or a Black Market Connections changeling). Infinite combo with Phyrexian Altar + another Zombie — sac for {B}, recast for {B}, infinite death triggers + infinite mana. Without the combo, provides repeatable sac fodder for Skullclamp, Grave Pact, and Meren XP counters.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Gravecrawler + Phyrexian Altar infinite death triggers

highlights.name: Priest of Forgotten Gods
highlights.reason: S-tier aristocrats card — sac outlet + card draw + {B}{B} mana + forced opponent sacrifice (stacks with Grave Pact) + life drain. All five per activation from a single 2-CMC creature. Human type means no Mikaeus undying, but Priest's value is the repeatable tap ability.

highlights.name: Plaguecrafter
highlights.reason: On entry each player sacrifices a creature or planeswalker of their choice; a player who can't discards a card. A no-target edict that answers hexproof and shroud commanders the targeted spot-removal suite cannot touch. Meren returns it every turn cycle — to the battlefield at 3+ experience — and your own sacrifice feeds experience and the drain package.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: DEC-572 board-approved swap for Nether Traitor

highlights.name: Braids, Arisen Nightmare
highlights.reason: At your end step, you may sacrifice an artifact, creature, enchantment, land, or planeswalker; each opponent may sacrifice a permanent sharing a card type with it, and each who doesn't loses 2 life and you draw a card — up to 3 draws per turn cycle. Fodder the deck already wants to sacrifice becomes cards or life loss, and every death feeds Meren experience and the drain package.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: DEC-572 board-approved swap for Sidisi, Regent of the Mire

highlights.name: Plumb the Forbidden
highlights.reason: Instant-speed mass card draw + sacrifice enabler. Sac X creatures as additional cost, draw X+1 cards. Board wipe response: sac everything, draw a new hand, trigger all death payoffs. Enables Sephiroth transform by saccing 4 in one shot.

highlights.name: Liliana, Dreadhorde General
highlights.reason: Static ability draws a card whenever a creature you control dies — S-tier in aristocrats. +1 creates 2/2 Zombie tokens for sac fodder. -4 is a sacrifice-based board wipe that synergizes with death payoffs. At 6 CMC, not reanimatable by Meren (targets creatures only), but castable by turn 4-5 with the deck's ramp suite.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Board-approved swap for Braids, Arisen Nightmare

highlights.name: Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler
highlights.reason: 3-CMC planeswalker that gives creature abilities haste (Fiend Artisan sacs+tutors a creature directly into play the turn it enters). -2 mills 3 and reanimates MV 2 or less for free — hits Blood Artist, Spore Frog, Sakura-Tribe Elder, Zulaport Cutthroat, Gravecrawler, Fiend Artisan. +1 untap doubles Yawgmoth or Fiend Artisan activations. A mini-Meren that skips XP requirements.

highlights.name: Teval's Judgment
highlights.reason: 3-CMC enchantment that rewards every graveyard exit with a choice of draw, Treasure, or 2/2 Zombie Druid. Meren's end-step reanimate, reanimate spells, Bloodghast/Gravecrawler self-recursion, and Living Death all trigger it. In a typical turn cycle with 3+ separate exits, you get all three modes. Survives Living Death and Toxic Deluge.

highlights.name: Hagra Mauling // Hagra Broodpit
highlights.reason: MDFC removal-or-land flex slot. Front face is a {2}{B}{B} instant `Destroy target creature` (costs {1} less if an opponent controls no basic lands). Back face is `{T}: Add {B}.` (enters tapped). Shores up two gaps simultaneously: raises lands from 36 to 37 toward the 39 target while adding a 6th instant-speed spot removal. Drawn early it's a land that always sees play; drawn late it's removal that never goes dead.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Board-approved swap for Cauldron of Essence (DEC-192) — raises land count 36→37 and adds 6th spot removal; replaces a 14th sac outlet/redundant reanimator the deck did not need

highlights.name: Deadly Rollick
highlights.reason: Free instant removal when Meren is on the battlefield. Exiles target creature at no mana cost, protecting combo turns and removing threats without tapping out.

sources.name: The Command Zone - Bracket 4 (Ep 731)
sources.detail: Rachel Weekes + Joe Johnson discuss Bracket 4 staples and deckbuilding

highlights.name: Massacre Wurm
highlights.reason: Creature-based board wipe that Meren loops. ETB gives opponents' creatures -2/-2, clearing go-wide boards while preserving your drain infrastructure. Static ability drains 2 life per opponent creature death — stacks with Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, and Bastion of Remembrance for 5 damage per death. Non-Human for Mikaeus undying. Cheated in via Buried Alive + Reanimate or Meren at 6 XP.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Board-approved swap for Caustic Caterpillar — addresses go-wide vulnerability while preserving drain battery

highlights.name: Fiend Artisan
highlights.reason: 2-drop B/G hybrid creature-tutor that puts a creature with MV <= X directly onto the battlefield. Unique angle in the deck — only Birthing Pod tutors to battlefield, and Pod is 4-mana setup locked to +1 MV jumps. Fiend Artisan is flexible: X=0 fetches Walking Ballista (library MV 0) for {B/G} — directly assembles the Ballista+Mikaeus 2-card infinite death-trigger combo from any sac fodder. X=1 fetches Gravecrawler or Forsaken Miner. X=2 fetches Blood Artist, Zulaport, Spore Frog, Bloodghast. X=3 fetches Yawgmoth, Sephiroth, Priest, Plaguecrafter, Grave Researcher. X=5 fetches Gray Merchant. Scales into a finisher (+1/+1 per creature card in graveyard — 15-25+ creatures in the yard mid-game). Non-Human Nightmare for Mikaeus undying. Recurs via Meren at 2+ XP. Every sac activation fires Blood Artist / Zulaport / Bastion / Sephiroth counter / Grave Pact / Meren XP / Yawgmoth proliferate / Insidious Roots Plant.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Mikaeus + Walking Ballista — Fiend Artisan tutors Ballista directly into play

highlights.name: Warren Soultrader
highlights.reason: Free, repeatable sacrifice outlet: pay 1 life and sacrifice another creature to create a Treasure. No mana to activate, so it chains as fast as you have fodder while ramping. Combos to a win with pieces already in the deck — Gravecrawler + Warren Soultrader + Blood Artist / Zulaport Cutthroat / Bastion of Remembrance loops infinitely (sac Gravecrawler for a Treasure, recast it for {B} from that Treasure, drain on every loop). Adds a fast sac outlet alongside the altars and Yawgmoth, and feeds the Treasure ramp the deck was short on.

sources.name: Gravecrawler + Warren Soultrader + Blood Artist
sources.detail: Infinite drain; surfaced via near-miss combo analysis

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: DEC-348 board-approved swap for Immoral Bargain

highlights.name: Black Market Connections
highlights.reason: Premier Bracket 4 advantage engine. Each precombat main phase choose any combination of: create a Treasure (lose 1 life), draw a card (lose 2), or make a 3/2 changeling body (lose 3). Three resource axes — ramp, cards, and fodder — on one 3-mana enchantment, scaling to the board state. The changeling counts as a Zombie for Gravecrawler and as sac fodder for Yawgmoth / Priest / Warren Soultrader; the Treasure fills the deck's ramp gap. Life cost is well-buffered by Kokusho, Gray Merchant, and Blood Artist.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: DEC-348 board-approved swap for Twilight Diviner; addresses ramp + card-advantage gaps

highlights.name: Heroic Intervention
highlights.reason: Two-mana insurance for a combo-reliant board. Gives all your permanents hexproof and indestructible until end of turn — blanks a board wipe (Toxic Deluge, Damnation, Blasphemous Act), protects a go-off turn from targeted removal, and shrugs off spot interaction aimed at Meren or a key engine piece. Directly addresses the deck's thin protection suite (previously just Spore Frog and Lightning Greaves).

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: DEC-348 board-approved swap for Witherbloom Charm; fills protection gap (metrics 2/4)

highlights.name: The Soul Stone
highlights.reason: Indestructible 2-mana black mana rock that converts late into a reanimation engine. Early it's a sticky `{T}: Add {B}` source that survives artifact/board hate (replaces Arcane Signet's slot — rock-for-rock, ramp count unchanged). Once harnessed (`{6}{B}, {T}, exile a creature you control`), its `∞` ability returns a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield every upkeep — hard-to-remove inevitability that stacks with Meren's end-step recursion. Tradeoff vs. Arcane Signet: taps for black only, a minor fixing hit the deck's ~25 remaining green sources absorb. Harness exiles (not sacrifices) the creature, so use an expendable token to avoid skipping death payoffs.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: DEC-348 board-approved swap for Arcane Signet (round 2); indestructible ramp + late reanimation engine

highlights.name: Forsaken Miner
highlights.reason: {B} 2/2 that returns from the graveyard to the battlefield for {B} whenever you commit a crime — no once-per-turn gate. Completes two Spellbook-verified infinite combos with cards already here: sac to Phyrexian Altar (or Warren Soultrader) with Blood Artist out, whose death trigger targets an opponent (a crime), and the floating {B} rebuys the Miner for a net-zero drain loop. Outside the combo it's endlessly recurring sac fodder — Blood Artist makes every creature death a crime window — feeding Skullclamp, Priest of Forgotten Gods, Yawgmoth, and Grave Pact edicts. Can't block, which this deck never asked it to do.

sources.name: Commander Spellbook
sources.detail: Discovered via decklist splice test; combos 2842-4050-5544 and 2842-5544-5670

highlights.name: Drivnod, Carnage Dominus
highlights.reason: Doubles every death-caused triggered ability of our permanents — a build-specific multiplier, not a crowd pick. Eleven cards in the 99 plus the commander gain real value: Grave Pact and Massacre Wurm fire twice per death (one sacrifice with both out = 24 total opponent life at a 4-player table), Meren banks two experience counters per death, and the drain suite (Blood Artist, Zulaport Cutthroat, Bastion of Remembrance) doubles. Meren's end-step return and sacrifice-worded triggers are not doubled. Warning: the activated ability exiles three creature cards from our graveyard — Meren's fuel — so treat it as an emergency-only line.
